# Documentation build tooling (MkDocs Material).
#
# This is NOT an application dependency. It is a build-time-only toolchain used
# by CI and for local docs preview — it is never installed into the app/worker
# Docker images (which are governed by pyproject.toml, the single source for
# runtime deps). Kept here, the RTD/MkDocs-idiomatic location, so a docs build
# never drags in the heavy runtime stack (llama-cpp, torch, chromadb): the code
# reference is generated by static analysis (griffe), which reads source files
# and does not import the package.
mkdocs-material>=9.5.0
mkdocstrings[python]>=0.24.0
mkdocs-render-swagger-plugin>=0.1.1
mkdocs-include-markdown-plugin>=6.0.0
